title: Stop thinking the enemy attacks you because you are weak. He attacks you because you are a threat.
paragraphs: Stop thinking the enemy attacks you because you are weak. He attacks you because you are a threat.

If your life feels like a constant battle right now, it’s not because you’re failing. It’s because you are sitting on potential that terrifying the darkness. The intensity of the fight is proof of the magnitude of your calling. Don't drop your sword now.
"Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour. Resist him, firm in your faith..." — 1 Peter 5:8-9 (ESV)
